{{Top|leg}}
The '''Scholastic Guardians''' were a group who controlled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obica]] centuries before the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The Guardians were loyal to the [[Spumani]] faith and would interrogate visitors to Obica, to ensure that they were members of the Spumani religion
